name: Gift of Life
description: You touch a humanoid or beast that has died within the last day and attempt to restore their life. The body must be mostly intact. The target must roll a 1d12; on a 1, the creature can no longer be a target of this spell. Each previous successful resurrection increases the required roll by 1. If successful, the creature returns to life with 1 health, 0 resolve, and gains the broken condition.
charge: The time limit extends to 7 days, and the creature returns with half their maximum health instead of 1 and does not gain the broken condition.
